_about: The VAWA self-petition's cover letter (src/fill/cover_letter.py): the firm's letterhead, signer and closing from the I-485 letter. The subject (the classification, an I-485 filed with it, 8 U.S.C. 1367), the address (the 'Attn: 1367' lockbox for the client's state: uscis.gov/Certain-VAWA-T-U-Filing-Locations, updated 02/05/2026) and the fee ($0: Form G-1055 10/01/26) come from src/vawa.py, which also adds the sealed I-693 and drops the photos when no I-485 goes with it. The letter names the client only, never the abuser or an address. DRAFT: the attorney approves this file before volume use.
